teachers.notes: Official checkpoint repository is marked MIT. The 1.13 GB teacher stays development-time because it is far too large for Android. The pinned source/checkpoint passed a real CPU reference-attention inference and produced four room polygons on a rights-safe smoke floorplan; adaptation emitted room_boundary only. Persisted KV/V cache buffers are ignored only by exact runtime-cache key patterns because upstream regenerates them from each inference sequence. Any other checkpoint/model mismatch remains fail-closed.

teachers.role: independent direct-raster wall/opening/room-segmentation teacher and second room-boundary vote

selectedCheckpoint.fingerprintMethod: official Google Drive file downloaded on clean GitHub Actions runner and SHA-256 hashed before pinning

teachers.roomBoundaryEvidence: high-confidence room segmentation transitions supported by wall/railing or a different room class; direct room-to-background transitions abstain
teachers.notes: Directly matches the application's raster input domain and provides wall, windows, doors and an independent room-boundary opinion derived from its own room segmentation. The boundary adapter is fail-closed: a crop/background edge alone is not architectural evidence. Because CubiCasa5K is CC-BY-NC-4.0, this teacher is development-time only for the current personal/non-commercial project and is never bundled in the public APK.

Allowed only as a personal/non-commercial development-time teacher. It is never bundled in the APK. The pinned checkpoint has passed real CPU inference on the hardened SHA-verifying adapter using the current official modern runtime. If project use becomes commercial, exclude it or retrain equivalent wall supervision from commercial-compatible data.

teachers.role: polygon/topology architecture reference; not a direct raster evidence source
teachers.notes: Upstream pretrained models target top-down density maps from 3D scans, not arbitrary raster drawings. Off-the-shelf RoomFormer output is never counted as an independent raster vote. Use only after an explicit raster adaptation/retraining step with compatible data and a separate validation contract.

teachers.role: continuity-aware edge/topology architecture reference and optional raster-adapted teacher

Upstream input is not the same as a raster floorplan screenshot, so no off-the-shelf CAGE output is accepted as direct evidence. It may be used only as a personal/non-commercial development-time teacher after explicit raster adaptation.
